messages:
DeployBot: Deploy started: release/redwood-runtime@v2.14.0 -> prod-eu2 (canary: 10%)
alex: heads-up — kicking off canary for 2.14.0, tagging commit 7a4f9d3
maria: noticed slightly higher 95th p95 on kv-cache in the first minute, watching
ken: can you paste the datapoint?
maria: `prod-eu2.kv-cache.latency.p95 = 142ms` vs baseline ~110ms, small but consistent for canary hosts
jamie: also seeing a couple of origin 502s from runtime-03 on the canary set, checking logs
DeployBot: Canary progressed to 25% after 3m — no auto-rollback triggered
jamie: log snippet: ```ERROR runtime: kv-fetch timeout after 150ms
stack: serve/handler.go:112 -> kv/cache.go:87```
alex: ok that 502s + latency increase is not great for this rollout. Recommend pausing and rolling back the canary.
maria: +1, reproduces on my canary pod when ramped to 50% load locally
ken: I can flip a rollback now. Who wants to confirm before I hit it? cc @oncall
jamie: confirm — initiate rollback to release/redwood-runtime@v2.13.7 and pin until root cause triaged
DeployBot: Rollback initiated by ken. Executing revert deploy: target release/redwood-runtime@v2.13.7 -> prod-eu2. Reason: increased kv-cache latency + 502s during canary
ops-bot: Change window reminder: rolling back during scheduled change window (22:00-02:00 UTC) — updating calendar
DeployBot: Rollback progress: reverting canary hosts... 3/10 done
DeployBot: Rollback completed: prod-eu2 now on release/redwood-runtime@v2.13.7 (rolled back by ken). Duration: 7m
alex: thanks. Pinning v2.13.7 on prod-eu2 and disabling auto-ramp for 2.14.0 until fix is in
maria: opened a short issue: https://redwood-internal/issue/INF-4422 "kv-cache p95 regression on 2.14.0" with logs and repro steps
jamie: we'll run a targeted load test and try to reproduce locally on a dev cluster, assigning to runtime team
ken: I'll follow up with a brief rollback note in the release channel and schedule a postmortem if we hit a regression window
DeployBot: Note added to deploy history: rollback to v2.13.7, reason: kv-cache latency spike + origin 502s during canary. Tags: rollback, hotfix-hold
alex: good work. If anything else crops up, @ken please escalate. We'll aim for a staging-only reattempt after fixes and perf regression tests pass.
